tests.name: substring_malicex

tests.name: lastmatch_malicex

weaknesses.title: FIRSTMATCH/LASTMATCH substring: alice matches malicex
weaknesses.detail: Needle alice is a substring of malicex. FIRSTMATCH bag alice returns malicex LOGIN when it appears first. Audit actor span is wrong — security-relevant false friend. No word-boundary or field-token match mode.
weaknesses.repro: FIRSTMATCH 'malicex LOGIN\nalice LOGIN' alice → malicex LOGIN

weaknesses.title: LASTMATCH same substring class corrupts pinlast attention
weaknesses.detail: If malicex is last field, LASTMATCH alice pins attacker line as 'last alice event'. Ops handoff boards mis-route attention.
weaknesses.repro: LASTMATCH with malicex last containing alice

weaknesses.title: No multi-line ARG — loadlines ||| glue required
weaknesses.detail: Audit lines have spaces; WORDS splits them. Same multi-line ARG gap as api_noise_rank.

weaknesses.title: LASTMATCH/FIRSTMATCH empty needle returns edge field
weaknesses.detail: Empty needle → last/first field. Agents with blank ARG can silently pick wrong event.

weaknesses.title: MAXLEN empty returns 0 (same class as MAX empty)
weaknesses.detail: MAXLEN "" → 0; MAXLEN_I -1 only if checked. Fat gate may false-pass if empty not BLANKed.

weaknesses.title: No token/field-prefix actor match
weaknesses.detail: Need CUTALL 0 + exact EQS walk for safe actor identity. FIRST/LASTMATCH insufficient for audit.
weaknesses.repro: prefer BEFORE line space + EQS actor

weaknesses.title: COUNTMATCH still substring-unsafe for cmatch tallies
weaknesses.detail: Same terror/error class on free-text audit lines.

workarounds: Match 'alice ' with trailing space or 'alice LOGIN' full token — still fragile
CUTALL first token then HASLINE/EQS for actor identity
Never trust FIRST/LASTMATCH for security actor spans without field split
BLANK bag before MAXLEN fat gate
loadlines ||| or READ file for multi-word events
